name: Manatsu no Ao, Gin'iro no Kimi
source:
During summer vacation Gaku comes to a remote island where his grandparents live, There he meets a silver-colored boy who does not know his name or where he lives. Boys spend summer vacations together, but eerie incidents start to occur on the island.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，乐来到了祖父母居住的一座偏远岛屿，在那里他遇到了一个不知道自己名字、也不知道住在哪里的银色男孩。男孩们一起度过暑假，但岛上却开始发生怪异事件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
